scripts.runCypress:preprod:report: rm -rf results/mochawesome results/preprod-report.html results/preprod-report.json && cypress run --config-file cypress.preprod.config.ts -b $BROWSER --reporter mochawesome --reporter-options reportDir=results/mochawesome,overwrite=false,html=false,json=true; npm run report:build && npm run report:open
scripts.report:build: mochawesome-merge results/mochawesome/*.json > results/preprod-report.json && marge results/preprod-report.json -f preprod-report -o results --inline
